samples.xml_description:
<module id="parallel2serial">
    <description>Parallel-to-Serial Converter: Converts 4-bit parallel data into a 1-bit serial output over 4 cycles.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="d" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit parallel data input.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Valid signal indicating the availability of serial output.</output>
        <output id="dout">Serial output representing the converted data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State IDLE.</parameter>
        <parameter id="LOAD">State LOAD.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SHIFT">State SHIFT.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[1:0]">Counter register.</reg>
        <reg id="data" width_description="[3:0]">Data register.</reg>
        <reg id="valid">Valid signal.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Assign the most significant bit of 'd' to 'dout'
        assign dout = d[3];
        
        // Sequential block triggered on positive edge of 'clk' or negative edge of 'rst_n'
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Asynchronous reset: Set 'cnt', 'data', and 'valid' to 0
                cnt <= 0;
                data <= 0;
                valid <= 0;
            end else begin
                // Check if 'cnt' is equal to 3
                if (cnt == 3) begin
                    // Load the parallel data into 'data' register
                    data <= d;
                    // Reset 'cnt' to 0
                    cnt <= 0;
                    // Set 'valid' signal to 1
                    valid <= 1;
                end else begin
                    // Increment 'cnt' by 1
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    // Set 'valid' signal to 0
                    valid <= 0;
                    // Shift 'data' register to the left by 1 bit
                    data <= {data[2:0], 1'b0};
                end
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
